items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Teo used to play with Tuxedo Band when I used to play with Tuxedo Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Eugene Deeson. I was in that one day. Yeah. You ever played alongside Lorenzo Teo, I guess? Lorenzo Teo?

Yeah. You played with him? Teo used to play with Tuxedo Band when I used to play with Tuxedo Band. Yeah, you played together. With originally Celestan. That's years ago. That's years ago. Then they started the band. How do you like playing the clarinet with the violin in the band? Who?
How do you like playing the clarinet with the violin? I would like it. Does the violin and clarinet work together good usually or are they about the same?
